verdict.rationale: Jira is a SaaS platform, so publishing a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only that Jira has APIs: 'Rich APIs' marketing copy and community use of REST queries. None of it documents a machine-readable spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Having a REST API is adjacent to the story, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
